entries.question: Opd appointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU, please follow one of the methods below. **Please note: Online registration is mandatory for all patients.**

### **Appointment Booking Methods:**
1.  **Online Portal (Recommended):** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in).
    *   Select State: **Uttar Pradesh**
    *   Select Hospital: **King George's Medical University (KGMU)**
    *   Click 'New Appointment' and follow the prompts.
2.  **Mobile App:** Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store and follow the same registration flow as the ORS portal.
3.  **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS with the text `"APPOINTMENT <NAME>"` to **8887019134**.
4.  **Phone:** You may call **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333** for assistance.

### **Important Information:**
*   **Registration Fee:** ₹50 flat for the OPD slip (payable via all booking methods).
*   **Arrival:** Please arrive at the hospital on the date and time specified in your appointment confirmation. Bring a printed copy of your appointment slip or the confirmation SMS.
*   **Referrals:** Patients coming from outside the city must bring a valid referral for their specific department.
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM). The hospital is closed on Sundays.

**Medical Disclaimer:** I am an AI assistant and not qualified to provide medical advice or diagnosis. If you have specific symptoms or health concerns, please consult a qualified doctor at the KGMU OPD or visit the nearest emergency facility if it is a medical emergency. **For your safety, please do not share personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat.**

    Sabse pehle [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jayein. Wahan apna mobile number daalkar register karein. Yeh portal 24/7 chalta hai aur isme kisi ko call karne ki zaroorat nahi padti. Aap wahan khud Neurology department aur date chun sakte hain.

2.  **Walk-in (On-Site) Registration:**
    Agar online booking mein dikkat aa rahi hai, toh aap **seedhe KGMU ke New OPD Block** mein subah jaldi (8:00 AM se pehle) pahunch jayein.
    *   **Zaroori cheez:** Apne saath **Aadhaar Card** aur **Mobile Number** zaroor rakhein (OTP ke liye).
    *   Counter par jakar aap wahan se ₹50 ki 'Parchi' (OPD slip) katwa sakte hain.
    *   *Dhyan rakhein:* OPD registration counter **1:00 PM** par band ho jaate hain, isliye jitna jaldi ho sake wahan pahunchein.

3.  **Emergency/Urgent Case:**
    Agar patient ki halat gambhir hai aur aap appointment ka wait nahi kar sakte, toh kripya samay barbad na karein aur seedhe **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** par jayein. Emergency services 24/7 khuli rehti hain.

**Ek zaroori baat:**
Main ek AI assistant hoon aur medical salah (diagnosis ya treatment) nahi de sakta. Agar patient ko tez bukhaar, behoshi, ya koi aur gambhir lakshan hain, toh kripya kisi doctor ya Emergency department se turant sampark karein.

entries.question: How to apply internship in KGMU
entries.answer:
To apply for an internship at King George's Medical University (KGMU), please follow these guidelines:

1.  **Check Eligibility and Departments:** KGMU offers various internship opportunities depending on your field of study (e.g., MBBS, Nursing, Dental, or Biomedical sciences). You should first identify the department you are interested in by visiting the [Department Directory](https://www.kgmu.org/department.php).
2.  **Contact the Department/Office:** Most internship requests are processed directly through the office of the Head of the Department (HOD) or the Dean's office. You can find contact details for specific departments or administrative offices in the [IP Phone Directory](https://kgmu.org/ipphonedirctory.php).
3.  **Submit a Formal Request:** You will generally need to submit a formal application letter addressed to the Registrar or the Dean of the respective faculty, along with a "No Objection Certificate" (NOC) or a recommendation letter from your current institution/college.
4.  **Check Official Guidelines:** For any specific rules regarding eligibility, fees, or duration, please refer to the [KGMU Guidelines page](https://kgmu.org/guidelines.php).
5.  **Visit the Website:** Keep an eye on the official website [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) under the "Notice" or "Careers/Opportunities" section for any specific internship notifications or recruitment drives.

**Note:** If you are a student from another institution, ensure you have your college's official authorization before applying. If you have specific questions about administrative procedures, you may contact the Registrar's Office at **0522-2253171**.

*I was created by Dr. Ayush Yadav.*

entries.question: book appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, please follow one of the methods below. **Please note that online registration is mandatory.**

### **Booking Methods:**

1.  **Online Portal (Recommended):**
    *   Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
    *   Select State (Uttar Pradesh) and Hospital (KGMU).
    *   Click 'New Appointment', choose your department, date, and time slot.
    *   Enter your details and pay the ₹50 fee online.
    *   Download your appointment slip.

2.  **Mobile App:**
    *   Download the **ABHA / Health Care App** from the KGMU Play Store.
    *   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

3.  **SMS Booking:**
    *   Send an SMS in the format: **"APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]"** to **8887019134**.

4.  **On-Site Walk-in:**
    *   Visit the registration counters at KGMU.
    *   **Requirements:** You must have your **Aadhaar Number** and an **active mobile number** (to receive the OTP).
    *   Pay the ₹50 fee at the counter to receive your physical OPD slip.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–1:00 PM | Sat 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Referral:** If you are visiting from outside the city, please bring a valid referral for your specific department.
*   **Safety Notice:** I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**. Also, please avoid sharing personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat for your safety.
